objective: Minimize Custom Scoreboard p99 render cost and allocations on frozen sidebar scenes while preserving the exact baseline layout and draw-command stream. Correctness is a hard gate; only solution.py is mutable.

meta.provenance: bounded exact layout/render-command extraction from Floyd Addons baseline 7c7360d4f68bf4505be64abc258ecf3067bb8dcf and reference ad9358c8

sourceDetails.derivation: bounded exact-output subsystem extracted for isolated deterministic evaluation

measurement.frames: frameReps per sealed case; frame 0 is the verified untimed scene-transfer frame, frames 1..frameReps-1 are the measured novel frames (trusted per-frame entry-value edits, verified against the trusted reference renderer)
measurement.q: per sealed case, 0 when any frame mismatches, else 0.6/(1 + p99_ms/0.6) + 0.4/(1 + peak_rss_mib/16); p99_ms = nearest-rank p99 across measured novel frames of the per-frame minimum over the nine fresh-process repetitions, timed by the trusted parent; peak_rss_mib = max kernel-reported candidate peak RSS across repetitions; capsule scalar = mean across sealed cases
measurement.qReferenceConstruction: qBase + max(5*sigma, 0.05*abs(qBase-qFail)) from the locked A-A calibration (stability aggregates of the pinned ordering report)
